title: Show each agent’s task and latest activity

sources.text: We show agents on the right panel. Image 1  However, we don't show what each agent did/does/is doing at a glance. Let's plan a fix fors this.

src/views/sidebar/checkout_panel.rs:1000–1125,1756–1845 renders grouped agent rows with name, status and activity tooltip. crates/grove-core/src/codex.rs:65–132 already holds task and activity; Codex collaboration and Claude agent registration populate task. Source evidence does not establish live provider behavior.
DESIGN.md and .agents/skills/grove-ui/SKILL.md: native checkout card, provider identity, fixed status space, session-owned disclosures, accessibility and native rendering checks.

claims.text: Lead with the assigned task so agents are distinguishable at a glance.

nodes.text: Proposed hierarchy · illustrative, not a pixel rendering

children.text: Latest: Permission check returned an error

decisions.prompt: How much activity should each agent show in the panel?

options.label: Task + latest activity (Recommended)
options.description: Show a stable task heading, identity/status line, and one activity line when it adds information. Taller rows give an immediate sense of progress.

options.label: Compact task rows
options.description: Show the task and identity/status only. Keep changing activity in the tooltip to preserve a shorter panel.

children.text: Keep the assignment stable while progress changes beneath it.

exhibit.text: Task: at most two lines. Metadata: provider identity glyph and agent name, with a reserved status slot. Activity: at most one line when distinct from the task. Working uses “Now”; finished/failed agents use “Latest”. These are the latest observed provider text, never generated summaries or proof of a successful task outcome. Unknown remains explicit; do not imply that stale activity is current.

children.text: Use available provider text without fabricating missing work.

exhibit.text: Heading fallback: nonempty normalized task → informative activity → provider name / Agent N. Skip duplicate activity. Keep full available task/activity in the shared tooltip and accessible name. When useful, disclose that activity is unavailable; avoid repeating empty-state copy on every row. Existing capped provider text cannot reveal content Grove never received.

claims.text: Preserve navigation, status clarity and session ownership as rows grow.

exhibit.text: Keep provider identity glyphs and semantic statuses. Long task/activity text yields before the fixed status area. Preserve stable agent ordering, current/previous grouping, running count, Show more, Previous agents and per-session disclosure preferences. Add no new row click action. Retain keyboard focus on existing controls; full text must be accessible without requiring hover. Expanded checkout content must remain outside the composer and fit narrow layouts.

children.text: Implement the presentation in the checkout card using existing native primitives.

entries.title: Task/activity presentation helper
entries.detail: Derive heading and optional activity from existing Subagent fields, preserving status semantics and grouping. Replace fixed 32px row assumptions with bounded content height and local named geometry constants.

entries.title: Render task-first rows
entries.detail: Use existing type tokens, theme colors, provider glyphs and shared tooltip/status recipes; preserve reserved status space and narrow-card behavior.

entries.title: Record the approved hierarchy
entries.detail: Update the checkout-card agent invariant alongside the implementation after the density decision. No skill change is expected.

claims.text: Verify displayed content and real provider updates separately for Codex and Claude.

exhibit.text: Codex: UNTESTED live; source inspection only. Claude: UNTESTED live; source inspection only. During implementation, exercise real spawn → activity → completion, failure and restart for each provider, plus reload and session switch. Record each as verified, unsupported or untested with method/blocker. Fixtures prove local presentation logic only. Do not infer live provider parity from common fields.

children.text: Focused checks catch wrong fallbacks and stale session content.

exhibit.text: Cover empty/whitespace task, activity-only agents, duplicate task/activity, long text, Working/Done/Failed/Unknown, late activity after completion, stable ordering, current/previous grouping and session ownership. Run relevant repository checks and conformance; orchestrator reads raw results independently.

children.text: Inspect the actual native card at narrow and wide widths.

exhibit.text: Record build/worktree and screenshot/interaction evidence. Check dark/light, long task and activity text, all affected statuses, keyboard focus and disclosures, tooltip/full accessible text, reduced motion, Show more/Previous agents, and no clipping, status overlap or composer obstruction. Report affected supported platforms as exercised or untested; no platform-specific behavior change is planned.

scope: Plan only. No application implementation, builds or installation. Native Review response and Send response resolve the density decision; feedback does not authorize implementation.

Estimated initial implementation: src/views/sidebar/checkout_panel.rs (presentation/helper and focused tests) plus DESIGN.md. No persistence schema, AI summarization or additional model calls. Touch core provider code only if live evidence establishes a missing-field defect, then revise scope.

After later implementation authorization: complete relevant checks and native QA, then run ./install.sh once at the selected final delivery endpoint unless the user defers installation. No release is included.
